numerical_recomputation.notes: Counts are modeled steps, not measured cycles.

evidence: Derived array insertion shift count n-i and removal count n-i-1.
Re-derived contiguous and linked abstraction correspondence for lookup and insertion.
Checked symbolic array, wrapper-node and intrusive space formulas without platform constants.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Cache and allocator effects are deliberately deferred or parameterized.

evidence: Reviewed empty/singleton, head/tail/middle, full/growth, overlap, move failure, null/sentinel cycles, detached/lost/shared nodes and inverse-link corruption.
Reviewed overflow, provenance, alignment, writable views, stale generation handles, wraparound, relocation, compaction, serialization, untrusted offsets and aircraft-control boundaries.

evidence: Live contiguous slots exactly cover abstract elements and unused capacity is excluded.
Linked reachability covers exactly owned logical nodes in order and permitted termination is explicit.
Every exposed address, iterator, view and handle follows a declared lifetime/invalidation rule.

evidence: Reviewed checked-address selection under index, overflow, bounds, lifetime, provenance and alignment premises.
Reviewed array shift ordering and link insertion correspondence for preserved prefix, inserted value and suffix.
Reviewed linked traversal by induction on position and generation-handle rejection by bounds/live/version cases.
